# China Bite

> Discover China, One Bite at a Time.

> Can I eat this? Check a Chinese dish in 10 seconds.
> Free: 3 checks/day. Kit: $6.99, 90 days, no ads.

## What it is

- China Bite tells first-time visitors to China if a dish is safe for them.
- Pick a diet profile, type a Chinese dish name, get: Can eat / Ask first / Avoid.
- Each dish shows: main ingredients, hidden risks, spice 0-3, reference price.
- QR ordering help: 80%+ of Chinese restaurants use QR ordering in WeChat.
- 12 big Chinese diet cards to show the waiter. Works offline.

## Cities (10)

- Shanghai 上海 — 生煎包, 小笼包, 红烧肉. Watch: food runs sweet, ask sweet/salty first; breakfast queues. Metro to People's Square / Jing'an Temple.
- Beijing 北京 — 北京烤鸭, 炸酱面, 煎饼果子. Watch: portions are big, 2 dishes feed 2 people; duck sold whole, ask price first. Metro to Wangfujing / Qianmen.
- Chengdu 成都 — 麻婆豆腐（无肉版）, 回锅肉, 担担面. Watch: most dishes are spicy, say 微辣 first; hot pot: start with clear broth. Metro to Chunxi Road / Kuanzhai Alley.
- Xi'an 西安 — 羊肉泡馍, 肉夹馍, 油泼面. Watch: Huimin Street, look for the green 清真 sign first; lots of lamb, ask about pork. Metro to Zhonglou Station, walk to Huimin Street.
- Guangzhou 广州 — 烧鹅, 虾饺, 肠粉. Watch: dim sum charges per person (tea fee extra); order by basket, a little at a time. Metro to Beijing Road / Shangxiajiu.
- Shenzhen 深圳 — 潮汕牛肉丸, 白切鸡, 肠粉. Watch: most eating is in malls and urban villages; small shops are Chinese-only menus, bring your diet card. Metro to Gangxia / Convention Centre.
- Hangzhou 杭州 — 狮子头, 鸡头米, 豆花. Watch: food runs sweet and light; West Lake area is pricey, ask price first. Metro to Longxiangqiao Station, walk to West Lake.
- Chongqing 重庆 — 清汤火锅, 番茄火锅, 凉粉. Watch: hot pot defaults to beef-tallow red broth, order clear or tomato broth if you can't take spice; noodles default very spicy, say 微辣. Metro to Jiaochangkou Station, walk to Jiefangbei.
- Kunming 昆明 — 过桥米线, 凉粉, 豆花. Watch: food runs sour-spicy; night-market menus are Chinese-only, bring your diet card; ask if mushrooms are farmed. Metro to Nanping Street Station.
- Guilin 桂林 — 桂林米粉, 凉拌木耳, 酸梅汤. Watch: Yangshuo West Street, ask price first; beer fish is not in this list, ask how it's made and the price. High-speed rail to Guilin Station, taxi in town; Yangshuo has no metro, take a car to West Street.

## Diet cards (12)

- Vegetarian, Vegan, Halal, Peanut allergy, Shellfish allergy, Egg allergy,
  Dairy allergy, Gluten-free, Tree nut allergy, Sesame allergy, Soy allergy, No spicy.

## How to use

1. Pick your diet profile.
2. Type a Chinese dish name (or tap a dish below).
3. Read the verdict. Show the big Chinese sentence to the waiter.
4. QR won't open? Use Route B: show the order slip, staff order on their phone.

- Guide only. Not medical advice. Can't confirm? Don't eat it.
